skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Strikes a single target with 2 combo strikes, each dealing 50% ATK DMG.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes all enemies with 3 combo strikes, each dealing 27% ATK DMG, with a 100% chance to inflict [Corrosion] on the main target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 20% ATK).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes all enemies with 3 combo strikes, each dealing 27% ATK DMG, with a 100% chance to inflict [Corrosion] on the main target and a 50% chance to inflict [Corrosion] on those around the main target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 20% ATK).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Inflicts [Weaken] on enemies affected by [Corrosion] (ATK reduced% for 1 turn).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Inflicts [Weaken] on enemies affected by [Corrosion] (ATK reduced by 30% for 1 turn).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Inflicts [Weaken] on enemies affected by [Corrosion] (ATK reduced by 37% for 1 turn).

effects.desc: Unfavorable effect reduces the target's damage reduction rate by 30% for the duration.
Corrosive damage over time effect, each turn dealing damage equal to a percentage of ST (e.g. 300%) to the target.
